clauses.title: Closed deliverable list
clauses.quote: Supplier deliverables are limited to current-state assessment, future-state process design, pilot workflow prototype, training kit and go-live readiness report.

clauses.title: Included workshops and interviews
clauses.quote: The plan includes two design workshops with Finance Operations leads and AP supervisors and up to eight stakeholder interviews named in Appendix B.

clauses.title: Readiness report executive dashboard
clauses.quote: The go-live readiness report includes an executive summary dashboard showing adoption risks, open decisions and launch readiness.

clauses.title: Prototype approver roles
clauses.quote: The pilot workflow prototype will represent approval roles for AP, Procurement and Legal for invoice exception routing.

clauses.title: Client data assumption
clauses.quote: Client will provide one clean export from ERP-X and TicketFlow by 2026-08-14; re-extracts, reconciliation and schema changes remain Client responsibility.

clauses.title: Data and integration exclusions
clauses.quote: Data cleansing, duplicate-vendor reconciliation, additional refreshes, schema remediation and new integrations are excluded.

clauses.title: Workshop, interview and training exclusions
clauses.quote: Workshops beyond the two included sessions, stakeholder groups not listed in Appendix B and training sessions beyond the training kit are excluded.

clauses.title: Legal workflow redesign exclusion
clauses.quote: Legal or compliance workflow redesign, policy interpretation and approval-authority redesign are excluded from this SOW.

clauses.title: Change-control route
clauses.quote: Additional work outside the deliverable list or caused by failed assumptions requires a written change order signed by both parties before performance.
